title: perfkit measurement engine
description: Stdlib-only Python 3.9+ engine shared by the skills: environment doctor, interleaved A/B with output check, robust comparison (bootstrap CI, Mann-Whitney), profile normalization to hotspot tables, scaling exponent, experiment ledger, policy suite and gate.

acceptanceCriteria.text: perfkit commands doctor, abtest, compare, hotspots, scaling, ledger, suite and gate exist and are documented
The engine test suite passes on Python 3.9 and 3.12
A planted regression fails the gate while a head-side policy loosening is ignored

finalSummary:
perfkit (stdlib, Python 3.9+): doctor, abtest (interleaved, paired, counters, hyperfine engine), compare, hotspots, scaling, ledger (+Quest notes), suite, gate. tests/: 43 passed on 3.12; 41 passed + 2 skipped on 3.9. Planted-regression gate test included. Delivered in feat/PSKI-14-release-v0.1.0; no checks configured.

Landed via opum-ai/profile-skills PR #1 (squash 6147a89; validated commit 387f82f, no checks configured) and promoted to main by fast-forward (PR #2).
